links.outcome: Mortality and downstream cardiac tests with versus without AI FFR-CT after CCTA
links.effect: No difference in all-cause mortality (aHR 1.00, 0.93-1.08) or cardiovascular mortality (aHR 0.96); fewer invasive angiograms (aHR 0.93, P<0.001) and noninvasive tests (189 vs 167 per 1,000).
links.quote: Implementation of an AI-diagnostic tool as part of a health intervention program was safe and beneficial to the patient pathway and health system with fewer cardiac tests at 2 years.

unlisted_practices: National government-funded AI implementation program evaluated with real-world observational outcomes

screen.reason: Observational cohort study evaluating real-world clinical and health system outcomes following the national implementation of an AI diagnostic tool (FFR-CT), but does not compare specific deployment practices or safeguards.
